name: Cantus
description: A Claude-first, local-first desktop coding environment for macOS (Apple Silicon). A native Tauri 2 app that pairs a Monaco editor with an integrated terminal running the Claude Code CLI, per-hunk and per-line git staging, resumable Claude sessions, a .claude workflow task runner, and a local SQLite-backed learned-memory store. Built as a full IDE alternative to Claude's desktop app.
community_quotes: The open-source IDE and GUI for Claude Code on macOS
Local-first, private, and free. Built with Tauri 2, Rust, and React — no Electron, no subscription
A real IDE and GUI built around the Claude Code CLI

name: roach-code
description: A config- and plugin-driven terminal AI coding agent supporting multiple models (DeepSeek, Codex/OpenAI, MiniMax, GLM). A multi-model rewrite of deepseek-reasonix, distributed as a single static Go binary with prefix caching for low token costs across long sessions.
community_quotes: An AI coding agent for your terminal
Multi-model & composable - any OpenAI-compatible endpoint is a config entry
Plugin-driven with external tools running as subprocesses over stdio JSON-RPC (MCP-compatible)

name: Ultracode
description: A local AI-assisted coding CLI inspired by Claude Code. Runs agentic coding workflows in your workspace with OpenAI-compatible models, function-calling tools, task planning, memory, permissions, hooks, background commands, MCP integration, and subagent support. Features interactive REPL sessions and one-shot run modes.
community_quotes: Terminal-first coding agent for developers
Built for the part of AI coding that happens inside a real repository
Follows the core Claude Code experience while backing into any OpenAI-compatible model

name: plumb-mcp
description: A local Figma MCP server with no REST rate limits, no metered tool-call quotas, and a verification loop. A drop-in alternative to Figma's Dev Mode MCP and Framelink for Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf that works on every plan including Free.
community_quotes: Local Figma MCP server - no REST rate limits, no metered tool-call quotas
Drop-in alternative to Figma's Dev Mode MCP
Works on every plan including Free

name: agentpet
description: A native macOS menu bar app with a desktop pet that monitors your AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI) in real time. Provides visual feedback and monitoring for terminal-based AI coding workflows.
community_quotes: A desktop pet that monitors your AI coding agents in real time
Native macOS menu bar app for monitoring Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI

name: MimoAgent
description: AI-powered coding assistant desktop app based on Xiaomi MiMo. Supports code generation, debugging, refactoring, project analysis, MCP tools, and TTS. A desktop application providing comprehensive AI coding assistance.
community_quotes: AI-powered coding assistant desktop app based on Xiaomi MiMo
Supports code generation, debugging, refactoring, project analysis

name: agentic-workspace-core
description: A portable repository-native foundation for agent memory, skills, handoffs, and knowledge workflows. Provides project-long memory and workspace management across AI coding sessions.
community_quotes: Portable repository-native foundation for agent memory, skills, handoffs
Knowledge workflows for AI agents

name: rx-gui (Reasonix)
description: JetBrains IDE AI Coding Assistant plugin (Reasonix GUI) featuring DeepSeek AI integration. Supports streaming conversations, Markdown rendering, code diff review, and cost tracking. Works across IntelliJ, PyCharm, and WebStorm.
community_quotes: JetBrains IDE AI Coding Assistant with DeepSeek AI
Supports streaming conversations, Markdown rendering, code diff review, and cost tracking

name: review-forge
description: An Agent Skill for structured, auditable code review workflows. Provides workflow-specific code review capabilities for AI coding agents.
community_quotes: Agent Skill for structured, auditable code review workflows

name: SigmaShake SSG
description: VS Code extension for AI governance, guardrails, audit, and .rules language support. Provides oversight and policy enforcement for Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini, and MCP assistants.
community_quotes: AI governance, guardrails, audit & .rules language support
Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini & MCP assistants

name: openclaw-devops-copilot
description: DevOps Copilot: an AI-powered assistant for DevOps workflows, infrastructure as code generation, and SRE tasks. Helps orchestrate complex development operations workflows.
community_quotes: AI-powered assistant for DevOps workflows
Infrastructure as code generation and SRE tasks

name: alethia-clients
description: VSCode extension and JetBrains plugin for Aletheia that passively detects and attributes AI-generated code contributions by serializing flagged metadata as git notes on each commit.
community_quotes: Passively detects and attributes AI-generated code contributions
Serializes flagged metadata as git notes on each commit

name: ai.nvim
description: A Neovim plugin for AI agent integration. Provides AI capabilities directly within the Neovim editor environment.
community_quotes: Your final AI plugin for Neovim

name: baton
description: Desktop app for cross-agent AI handoffs. Pass project context, git diffs, and task states seamlessly between Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and other AI coding agents.
community_quotes: Desktop app for cross-agent AI handoffs
Pass project context, git diffs, and task states between different AI coding agents

name: inline
description: Inline comments from an AI coding agent to your IDE. Designed for developers who prefer IDE integration over terminal-based AI coding agents or desktop apps.
community_quotes: Inline comments from an AI coding agent to your IDE
For those who can't read off a terminal
